fluence_model.authority: Nakazato et al., Astrophys. J. Suppl. 205 (2013) 2, arXiv:1210.6841
fluence_model.database: Supernova Neutrino Database, Nakazato, guide dated 2021-06-15
fluence_model.file_format: First row is total N_nue, N_nuebar, N_nux, E_nue, E_nuebar, E_nux; nux denotes the average of nu_mu, anti-nu_mu, nu_tau, anti-nu_tau and therefore carries multiplicity four for all-flavour totals. Remaining rows are 20 energy bins with differential number [/MeV] and energy [erg/MeV], integrated to 20 s.

source_size.authority: Delfan Azari et al., arXiv:1910.06176, self-consistent 2D Boltzmann CCSN simulation
source_size.authority_statement: vicinity of the neutrino sphere at r approximately 16-21 km
source_size.role: independently frozen finite-source geometry control only

occurrence_rate.authority: Rozwadowska, Vissani & Cappellaro, New Astronomy 83 (2021), arXiv:2009.03438

direction_model.primary_scale_height_authority: Quintana, Wright & Martinez Garcia, MNRAS 538 (2025) 1367, arXiv:2503.08286
direction_model.interpretation: fixed-10-kpc thin-disk smooth-sky control; utility must also report the isotropic random-sky cap as an independent simple control
direction_model.guard: No delta-function Galactic plane is admissible; observed massive-star vertical thickness is finite.

provenance_notes: The 10-kpc distance is preregistered normalization, not an occurrence prediction.
The source-radius authority is kept separate from the fluence normalization and is not used to renormalize it.
No detector, metastable, resonance or structured-matter gain is included.
